name: Screw Puzzle
tagline: Relaxing nut & bolt puzzle challenges for sharp minds.
description:
Screw Puzzle: Wood Nut & Bolt is a satisfying brain teaser game built around logic, focus, and problem-solving. Unscrew bolts, match nuts correctly, and clear increasingly difficult levels in a calming wooden puzzle environment.

Designed for quick play sessions and relaxing gameplay, Screw Puzzle combines smooth controls with progressively challenging mechanics that test your thinking skills.

Whether you want a casual time-pass game or a proper logic challenge, Screw Puzzle delivers an addictive and rewarding puzzle experience for players of all ages.
